scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm openapi:check && pnpm test && pnpm --filter gavel-live-web build && pnpm --filter gavel-live-web test:render && pnpm --filter gavel-live-web exec cf deploy --prebuilt --dry-run --mode production && pnpm deploy:dry-run
scripts.deploy:dry-run: pnpm build && cf deploy --prebuilt --dry-run --mode production && pnpm build --mode staging && cf deploy --prebuilt --dry-run --mode staging
scripts.deploy:staging: pnpm build --mode staging && cf deploy --prebuilt --mode staging
scripts.lint: pnpm types && oxlint --deny-warnings --type-aware src test scripts vitest.config.ts vite.config.ts && pnpm --filter gavel-live-web lint && pnpm lint:anti-slop
scripts.typecheck: pnpm types && tsc --noEmit && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p test/production/tsconfig.json --noEmit
